Dependency floors and support checks

Source: vignettes/articles/contributor-tools-hardening-dependencies-readme.Rmd
contributor-tools-hardening-dependencies-readme.Rmd

Contributing · Object model · Discovery walkthrough · Object fields

DESCRIPTION declares testthat >= 3.1.8, the first genuinely qualified candidate for the current tests. R >= 4.1 is retained.

The former 3.0.0 claim omitted unconditional newer APIs. A full inventory and real installation showed that 3.1.7 exports all 28 APIs used, but this is not sufficient: its namespace-only local_mocked_bindings() cannot mock the imported S4 print binding required by the public sink error/interrupt regression. Both full 3.1.7 runs (macOS R4.4.1 and Linux R4.1.3) produced the same sole error: 253 cases, 5,495 passes, zero failed expectations/warnings, ten explicit skips. Those rejected-candidate receipts remain under evidence/testthat-3.1.7/.

The official v3.1.8 implementation adds imported-binding rebinding. Genuine, unmodified archived 3.1.8 was installed in the isolated Mac library and in a Linux container. The direct imported-print error probe passes. Final exact-source full suites pass on both runtimes: 253 cases, 5,505 passing expectations, zero failures, errors or warnings, and ten explicit optional/backend skips each. Receipts are in evidence/r44/ and evidence/r41/. testthat-floor-primary-evidence.json binds the source URLs/archive hashes. The final tested source is 169c16e4ba00c687c1f03fe37e9d79a11d01cd8f, including the final qualified methods::slotNames call. The declared-namespace probe passes with R_DEFAULT_PACKAGES=NULL in both runtimes. The earlier clean 8c checkpoint remains separate under evidence/core-8c-testthat-3.1.8/. No error/interrupt/ownership test was weakened to retain the earlier floor.

inventory-testthat.R parses every tests/tools R script. It records all syntactic exported calls, including conditional sites, in testthat-calls.tsv; future conventional expectation/skip/local/with/capture APIs are detected even when absent from the running floor, while project assertion helpers are excluded. API/argument columns are complete and call excerpts are capped at 300 characters. testthat-api-arguments.json summarizes named arguments. Qualified namespace references were also cross-checked by text search. CI regenerates the inventory before probing; the standalone probe generates it if missing. A clean temporary checkout without generated files passed, and an unknown future API was detected. probe-testthat-floor.R checks every export at exactly 3.1.8, representative regexp/fixed/ignore.case/ tolerance/info argument forms, namespace mocks, and the required imported-print behavior against an installed package. run-floor-suite.R asserts the actual R minor version, testthat version and isolated package locations before testing.

Mac installations went only into /private/tmp/sceptre-r44-floor-library; ordinary R4.4 libraries were read as fallback dependency locations. Genuine R4.4.1 arm64 and R4.6.0 arm64 are locally installed. Old testthat3.1.7 failed to compile on R4.6 because it uses removed R internals; the log is preserved. Current R checks use current testthat rather than pinning that old combination.

An initial Docker probe found no socket. A later sandbox probe was denied; escalated read-only inspection confirmed Docker29.4.3 Linux/aarch64. The pinned official native-arm64 R4.1.3 image then parsed all 108 package/test R files. Compatible snapshot dependencies and genuine testthat were built inside isolated images; package compilation and tests use a disposable container, read-only source mount, network disabled, and one writable evidence mount. Dockerfile.r41 and run-r41-container.sh make that setup reviewable. The derivative 3.1.8 image preserves the initial 3.1.7 image/diagnostic receipts.

The R4.1 setup resolves from the coherent 2024-03-01 CRAN source snapshot, avoiding impossible newest-dependency combinations. Snapshot audit identified 79 recursively required repository entries compatible with R4.1.0, including Matrix1.6-5 (R>=3.5) and MASS7.3-60.0.1 (R>=4.0), then pins exact testthat3.1.8. The index contains multiple R-specific Recommended rows; the audit applies R-version filtering before selecting them, as available.packages() does. base-image-installed.tsv is the initial dependency image’s historical receipt; final floor session/package tables identify the actually executed testthat3.1.8.

The existing OS/release/oldrel and ondisc-absent jobs remain. The standard matrix adds R-devel. check-support.yaml adds R4.1 with the compatible snapshot, exact testthat floor, installed import-mock probe and R CMD check; and official Bioconductor release (latest) / devel containers using their matching repos, R CMD check and BiocCheck. BiocCheck’s quit status fails for errors; existing warnings/notes remain reviewable, including the infrastructure-dependency warning. No meaningless dependency is added to hide it. Optional ondisc stays absent in these new support jobs; the existing pinned-backed job retains its separate contract. All new hosted checks are configured but unexecuted: no workflow was pushed or dispatched. Windows, R-devel and Bioconductor-container success are not inferred from local Mac/Linux evidence.

Primary references: testthat3.1.7 mocking source, testthat3.1.8 mocking source, official3.1.8 archive, r-lib setup-r inputs, r-lib dependency action, and Bioconductor containers.
